question_text: Republic Act No. 9512, also known as the National Environmental Awareness and Education Act of 2008, mandates the integration of environmental education into school curricula. Which of the following is a key requirement of this law?

options.text: Environmental education shall be integrated into the curricula of all public and private schools, from elementary to tertiary levels, including non-formal education.
Environmental education is optional and only required for science majors in college.
Only public schools are required to integrate environmental education; private schools may choose to do so.
Environmental education is limited to the elementary level only.
